description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Teemo''' tosses a poisonous mushroom to the target location that becomes [[File:Noxious Trap.png|20px|link=Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|An icon representing the keyword Stealthed trap]] [[:Stealth#Stealthed_traps_and_wards|stealthed]] after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 5 minutes and granting [[File:Sight icon.png|20px|link=Sight|An icon representing the keyword Sight]] [[:Sight|sight]] of its surroundings. If the mushroom lands on one that has already been placed, it will bounce forward from the placed mushroom for its cast distance, up to a cap, which can happen repeatedly.
description.text: Active: Teemo tosses a poisonous mushroom to the target location that becomes stealthed after arming over 1 second, lasting for up to 5 minutes and granting sight of its surroundings. If the mushroom lands on one that has already been placed, it will bounce forward from the placed mushroom for its cast distance, up to a cap, which can happen repeatedly.

description2.raw: '''Teemo''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Noxious Trap'' charge, up to a maximum amount.
description2.text: Teemo periodically stocks a Noxious Trap charge, up to a maximum amount.

description3.raw: The mushroom will explode upon enemy contact, inflicting [[File:Poison icon.png|20px|link=Cassiopeia/LoL|An icon representing the keyword Poison]] [[:Cassiopeia/LoL|poison]] to nearby enemies and [[File:Slow icon.png|20px|link=Slow|An icon representing the keyword Slow]] [[:Slow|slowing]] them for 4 seconds, as well as [[File:Reveal icon.png|20px|link=Sight#Standard sight|An icon representing the keyword Standard sight]] [[:Sight#Standard sight|revealing]] them.
description3.text: The mushroom will explode upon enemy contact, inflicting poison to nearby enemies and slowing them for 4 seconds, as well as revealing them.

description4.raw: '''[[File:Poison icon.png|20px|link=Cassiopeia/LoL|An icon representing the keyword Poison]] poison:''' The target takes magic damage every second over 4 seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.
description4.text: poison: The target takes magic damage every second over 4 seconds. Subsequent inflictions refresh the duration.

description5.raw: A mushroom has [[File:Health icon.png|15px|link=Health]] 6 '''maximum''' health and can only be damaged by [[File:Champion icon.png|20px|link=Champion|An icon representing the keyword Champion]] [[:Champion|champion]] basic attacks (2 damage from [[File:Ranged role.png|20px|link=Ranged|An icon representing the keyword Ranged]] [[:Ranged|ranged]] and 3 from [[File:Melee role.png|20px|link=Melee|An icon representing the keyword Melee]] [[:Melee|melee]]).
description5.text: A mushroom has  6 maximum health and can only be damaged by champion basic attacks (2 damage from ranged and 3 from melee).

notes.raw: * ''Noxious Trap'' deals [[File:Poison Trail.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Persistent area damage]] [[:Damage|persistent area damage]], additionally tagged as [[File:Irelia Vanguard's Edge.png|20px|link=Damage|An icon representing the keyword Indirect damage]] [[:Damage|indirect damage]], and applies [[File:Blackfire Torch item.png|20px|link=Ability effects|An icon representing the keyword Ability effects]] [[:Ability effects|spell effects]]. * The bounce can occur an indefinite amount of times while '''Teemo''' is alive. If '''Teemo''' dies before ''Noxious Trap'' bounces on another, the trap will disappear. * [[File:Rift ScuttlerSquare.png|20xpx|border|link=Rift Scuttler|An icon representing Rift Scuttler]] [[Rift Scuttler]] will not trigger ''Noxious Trap's'' explosion if it is not being attacked. * Enemies who step on multiple ''Noxious Traps'' will only refresh the duration of the damage over time and slow. * ''Noxious Trap's'' damage is determined when it detonates and not when planted, meaning if '''Teemo's''' [[File:Ability power icon.svg|15px|link=Ability power]] ability power changes, the scaling is also altered to affect the active damage of all ''Noxious Traps'' so long as they do not explode. * [[File:Spell Shield.png|20px|link=Spell shield|An icon representing the keyword Spell shield]] [[:Spell shield|Spell shield]] will prevent the damage over time and slow for all units but will not prevent the detonation itself.
notes.text:
Noxious Trap deals persistent area damage, additionally tagged as indirect damage, and applies spell effects.
The bounce can occur an indefinite amount of times while Teemo is alive. If Teemo dies before Noxious Trap bounces on another, the trap will disappear.
Rift Scuttler will not trigger Noxious Trap's explosion if it is not being attacked.
Enemies who step on multiple Noxious Traps will only refresh the duration of the damage over time and slow.
Noxious Trap's damage is determined when it detonates and not when planted, meaning if Teemo's  ability power changes, the scaling is also altered to affect the active damage of all Noxious Traps so long as they do not explode.
Spell shield will prevent the damage over time and slow for all units but will not prevent the detonation itself.
